column5: reference_data_preparation.R --step hg_reference_1: ALT/HLA/decoy contig filter over test_contigs.fa (keeps chr22 + chr1_KI270706v1_random); deterministic, no embedded paths.

reference_data_preparation.R --step hg_gtf_1: chr-prefix-stripped reformat of the 109-gene chr22 exon GTF against a no-chr FASTA (5765 lines); deterministic (Ensembl-GTF passthrough, no rtracklayer date header), no embedded paths.
reference_data_preparation.R --step faidx: Rsamtools .fai index (name/length/offset/linebases/linewidth) of test_contigs.fa (5 contigs); deterministic, no embedded paths.

gff3_to_gtf.R rtracklayer GTF export of mini.gff3 (4 feature rows); value-compared with ignore_lines masking the two volatile header lines ('##source-version rtracklayer <ver>' + daily '##date YYYY-MM-DD'). Feature rows are byte-deterministic; no embedded paths.

SUPPA_annotation_1: `suppa generateEvents` SE .ioe (104 events) over the chr22 GTF. Content is deterministic but the transcript-ID tokens in the comma-separated columns come out in a non-deterministic (set) order; test compares a token-sorted + row-sorted projection (_ioe_sorted). Committed fixture is the canonical (sorted) form.

SUPPA_annotation_2: reference_data_preparation.R --step suppa_annot -> psichomics prepareAnnotationFromEvents (list of 7 per-event-type data.frames). Same event SET each run but inherits the .ioe's non-deterministic ROW order, so compared with sort_rows=True (each data.frame canonically row-sorted); values then match at 1e-6.
